title: Kuusi Article
description: Reading appearance for Markdown and notebook Article views.

fontSize.description: A size step, or a custom size in CSS px.

color.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the page foreground.

theme.title: Article theme
theme.description: Named preset for page measure, padding, background, and paragraph spacing. Text and heading styles stay under their own menus.

measure.title: Article measure
measure.description: Column width of the Article reading pane.

padding.title: Article padding
padding.description: Horizontal page inset of the Article column in rem (1 rem ≈ 4.2 mm); the top margin is 1.125× and the bottom 2× this value.

columnAlign.title: Article column alignment
columnAlign.description: Horizontal placement of the reading column in the pane.

columns.title: Article columns
columns.description: Number of text columns (1 or 2). In paged layout each page has its own columns.

pageLayout.title: Article page layout
pageLayout.description: Scroll for continuous reading, or paged for print-style paper preview (PDF-like).

paperSize.title: Article paper size
paperSize.description: Paper size used when page layout is paged.

paperOrientation.title: Article paper orientation
paperOrientation.description: Portrait or landscape paper when page layout is paged.

paperBorderWidth.title: Article paper edge width
paperBorderWidth.description: Border thickness around each paper sheet in px (0–12).

paperBorderColor.title: Article paper edge color
paperBorderColor.description: CSS hex color for the paper sheet edge. Empty uses a soft default.

paperShadow.title: Article paper shadow
paperShadow.description: Cast a drop shadow around each paper sheet.

paperShadowWidth.title: Article paper shadow width
paperShadowWidth.description: Soft shadow blur radius around each paper sheet in px (0–64).

imageWidth.title: Article image width
imageWidth.description: How wide images may grow inside the Article column.

imageAlign.title: Article image alignment
imageAlign.description: Horizontal placement when images sit on their own line.

imageWrap.title: Article image wrap
imageWrap.description: Whether following text wraps beside the image.

imageBorderColor.title: Article image border color
imageBorderColor.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the page foreground.

background.title: Article paper background
background.description: Color of the paper the article is printed on.

backgroundPattern.title: Article paper pattern
backgroundPattern.description: Texture overlay on the paper, not the pane behind it.

viewBackground.title: Article view background
viewBackground.description: Solid color of the pane behind the paper.

viewBackgroundColor.title: Article view background color
viewBackgroundColor.description: CSS hex color (#rgb / #rrggbb) for the pane behind the paper. Empty uses viewBackground.

font.title: Article body font
font.description: Font family for Article body text.

fontSize.title: Article body font size
fontSize.description: Body size for the Article reading pane.

color.title: Article body color
color.description: Body text color. Empty follows the page foreground.

letterSpacing.title: Article letter spacing
letterSpacing.description: Tracking for body text, in pt (0–3).

lineHeight.title: Article leading
lineHeight.description: Line-height multiplier for Article body paragraphs (0.9–3).

paragraphSpacing.title: Article paragraph spacing
paragraphSpacing.description: Vertical space between body paragraphs, in pt (0–48).

paragraphIndent.title: Article paragraph indent
paragraphIndent.description: First-line indent for body paragraphs, in pt (0–72).

linkStyle.title: Article link style
linkStyle.description: How hyperlinks are emphasized in the Article body.

codeStyle.title: Article code style
codeStyle.description: Appearance of inline code and fenced code blocks.

codeTheme.title: Article code palette
codeTheme.description: Syntax colors for highlighted code. Notebook follows JupyterLab theme colors.

codeFont.title: Article code font
codeFont.description: Monospace face for inline and fenced code.

codeFrame.title: Article code frame
codeFrame.description: Draw a border around fenced code blocks. Unset follows the code style (Plain and Contrast are framed).

codeFrameColor.title: Article code frame color
codeFrameColor.description: CSS hex color, or empty to follow the page foreground.

codeFrameRadius.title: Article code corner radius
codeFrameRadius.description: Corner radius of code blocks, in px (0–24).

codeFrameBorder.title: Article code frame stroke
codeFrameBorder.description: Border width of the code frame, in px (0–8).

codeFrameWidth.title: Article code block width
codeFrameWidth.description: Maximum width of code blocks, as percent of the column (40–100).

tableStyle.title: Table style
tableStyle.description: Word- and LaTeX-inspired table presets (default Booktabs).

tableBorderWidth.title: Table border width
tableBorderWidth.description: Rule / grid stroke thickness in pt (0.25–3).

tableTransparency.title: Table background transparency
tableTransparency.description: Transparency of table cell fills in percent: 100 lets the page show through, 0 keeps opaque rows.

tableHeaderRowBold.title: Bold table header row
tableHeaderRowBold.description: Make the first row (column headers) bold.

tableHeaderColumnBold.title: Bold table first column
tableHeaderColumnBold.description: Make the first column (row headers) bold.

tableHeaderRowAlign.title: Article table header row alignment
tableHeaderRowAlign.description: Text alignment of the table header row; auto keeps the table style's own.

tableHeaderColumnAlign.title: Article table header column alignment
tableHeaderColumnAlign.description: Text alignment of the first column; auto keeps the table style's own.

listStyle.title: List style
listStyle.description: Vertical density for unordered and ordered lists.

blockquoteWeight.title: Blockquote weight
blockquoteWeight.description: Border and emphasis weight for blockquotes.

headers.title: Article headers
headers.description: Per-level heading styles (H1–H6): font, size, color, and alignment.

pageHeaderText.title: Article page header
pageHeaderText.description: Running header on every page in paged layout. Placeholders: {title}, {page}, {pages}.

pageFooterText.title: Article page footer
pageFooterText.description: Running footer on every page in paged layout. Placeholders: {title}, {page}, {pages}.

pageNumber.title: Article page numbers
pageNumber.description: Page number format in paged layout: none, 3, 3 / 12, – 3 –, [3], Page 3, Page 3 of 12, iii or III.

pageNumberStart.title: Article page number start
pageNumberStart.description: Number from the first page, or skip the first and start on page 2.

showTextCount.title: Show character / word count
showTextCount.description: Display character and word counts beside zoom.

showPageCount.title: Show page count
showPageCount.description: Display the article page count beside zoom.

showFileSize.title: Show file size
showFileSize.description: Display the document file size beside zoom.

pageHeaderRule.title: Header rule
pageHeaderRule.description: Draw a thin line under the running header.

pageFooterRule.title: Footer rule
pageFooterRule.description: Draw a thin line above the running footer.

pageFirstDifferent.title: Different first page
pageFirstDifferent.description: Leave header and footer text empty on the first page.

tableRepeatHeader.title: Repeat table headers
tableRepeatHeader.description: Repeat table header rows on every page a table spans.

coverPage.title: Cover page
coverPage.description: Insert a cover page (title and date) before the contents.

coverTitle.title: Cover title
coverTitle.description: Title on the cover page; empty uses the document name.

coverAuthor.title: Cover author
coverAuthor.description: Author line on the cover page; empty leaves it out.

coverDate.title: Cover date
coverDate.description: Date text on the cover page; empty uses today's date.

codeLineNumbers.title: Code line numbers
codeLineNumbers.description: Number the lines of code blocks.

imageCaptions.title: Image captions
imageCaptions.description: Show an image's alt text as a numbered caption beneath it.

hyphenate.title: Hyphenation
hyphenate.description: Break long words at syllables so justified text sets more evenly.

linkFootnotes.title: Link footnotes
linkFootnotes.description: Number links in the text and list their addresses at the end.

pdfBookmarks.title: PDF bookmarks
pdfBookmarks.description: Write one bookmark per heading into exported PDFs.

pageHeaderMirror.title: Mirror header on even pages
pageHeaderMirror.description: Swap left and right header/footer alignment on even pages (book spreads).

codeTabSize.title: Code tab width
codeTabSize.description: Spaces per tab in code blocks.

marginTopMm.title: Top margin
marginTopMm.description: Top page margin in mm; 0 follows the padding setting.

marginBottomMm.title: Bottom margin
marginBottomMm.description: Bottom page margin in mm; 0 follows the padding setting.

marginLeftMm.title: Left margin
marginLeftMm.description: Left page margin in mm; 0 follows the padding setting.

marginRightMm.title: Right margin
marginRightMm.description: Right page margin in mm; 0 follows the padding setting.

marginGutterMm.title: Gutter
marginGutterMm.description: Extra inner margin for binding, added to the left margin (mm).

orphanLines.title: Orphan / widow lines
orphanLines.description: Minimum lines of a paragraph left at the bottom or carried to the top of a page.

indentChars.title: First-line indent (characters)
indentChars.description: First-line indent in characters, for Chinese paragraphs (2 = two characters).

tableFontPercent.title: Table text size
tableFontPercent.description: Table text size as a percentage of body text.

watermarkText.title: Watermark
watermarkText.description: Diagonal text drawn behind every page, such as DRAFT.

columnRule.title: Column rule
columnRule.description: Draw a line between the two columns.

columnRuleStyle.title: Column rule style
columnRuleStyle.description: Line style of the column rule.

columnRuleWidth.title: Column rule width
columnRuleWidth.description: Thickness of the column rule in px.

columnRuleColor.title: Column rule color
columnRuleColor.description: Color of the column rule; empty follows the text color.

tableBandColor.title: Table band color
tableBandColor.description: Color of banded table rows; empty follows the text color.

pdfQuality.title: PDF image quality
pdfQuality.description: JPEG quality of exported PDF pages.

headingNumbering.title: Heading numbering
headingNumbering.description: Number headings 1 / 1.1, or I / 1.1 ("chinese" is the old name for "roman").

headingNumberStart.title: Heading number start
headingNumberStart.description: First heading level that gets a number; H2 leaves the document title (H1) unnumbered.

headingNumberDepth.title: Heading number depth
headingNumberDepth.description: Heading levels that get a number: H1 only, H1 and H2, or all.

chapterBreak.title: Chapter page break
chapterBreak.description: Start every H1 (or H1 and H2) on a new page.

tocShow.title: Contents page
tocShow.description: Insert a table of contents at the start of the document.

tocDepth.title: Contents depth
tocDepth.description: Heading levels listed in the contents.

tocShowH1.title: Show Heading 1 in contents
tocShowH1.description: List Heading 1 (usually the document title) in the contents.

tocShowTitle.title: Show contents title
tocShowTitle.description: Show the heading above the contents list.

tocTitle.title: Contents title
tocTitle.description: Heading of the contents page; empty uses the localized default.

strongColor.title: Article bold color
strongColor.description: Color for bold (**strong**) body text. Empty inherits the body color.

codeBackground.title: Article code background color
codeBackground.description: Background of fenced code blocks, as a CSS color; empty keeps the code theme's own.

blockquoteBackground.title: Article quote background color
blockquoteBackground.description: Background of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.

blockquoteColor.title: Article quote text color
blockquoteColor.description: Text color of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.

blockquoteBarColor.title: Article quote bar color
blockquoteBarColor.description: Color of the vertical bar of block quotes, as a CSS color; empty keeps the quote weight's own.
